name: Amazon.com, Inc.

segments.note: The three segments add up to total operating income of $80.0B.

footnotes: Capital expenditures, net = operating cash flow − free cash flow (purchases of property & equipment net of proceeds and incentives).
Equity-method line is derived as pre-tax income − tax − net income. Total liabilities = total assets − equity. Net cash excludes lease liabilities.
Percentages are of net sales; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Amazon grew revenue 12.4% to $716.9B in 2025 and lifted operating income 16.6% to $80.0B. Net income rose 31% to $77.7B, or $7.17 per diluted share, helped by $17.3B of non-operating income.

Cash generation stayed strong: operating cash flow rose 20% to $139.5B. But net capital spending jumped 65% to $128.3B as Amazon built out AI and data-center capacity, so free cash flow fell 71% to $11.2B.
highlights: AWS grew 19.6% to $128.7B and earned $45.6B of operating income, 57% of the company total.
North America's margin improved to 6.9% from 6.5%; International reached 2.9%.
Gross margin widened to 50.3% from 48.9% as higher-margin services grew faster than retail.
watch: AWS margin slipped to 35.4% from 37.0%, and technology & infrastructure cost grew 23%, the fastest of any expense line.
In its Q4 release, management said it expects about $200B of capital expenditures in 2026, which will keep pressure on free cash flow.
Q4 operating income absorbed about $2.4B of special charges (Italian tax disputes and a lawsuit, severance, impairments).
Long-term debt rose to $65.6B from $52.6B, though cash and securities rose faster.

revenueLine.cap: Online stores were the largest line at $269.3B, and AWS grew about 20%.
revenueLine.say: Online stores were the largest line, at 269 billion dollars, and A W S grew about 20 percent.

spotlights.cap: AWS earned $45.6B of operating income, 57% of the company total, on $128.7B of revenue.
spotlights.say: A W S was the profit engine: 45.6 billion dollars of operating income, 57 percent of the company total, on 128.7 billion dollars of revenue.
